column1: # The script table for the alias-day leg: one row per athome script, copied
# stage 2), plus run_onchange_17-install-grofe, the grofe step the alias-day
# ref adds. A script in the athome archive with no row here fails stage 2, so
# a new athome script cannot slip through unreviewed.
#   script   the file under home/.chezmoiscripts, without .tmpl
#   action   run      rendered and run, ATHOME_CI unset
#            ci       rendered and run with ATHOME_CI=1, which it honours
#            flag     rendered and run with the env in column 3
#            absent   must not be in the archive; stage 2 fails if it is
#   how      the env a flag row runs with, or how the row is skipped
#   why      the reason, printed in the report
